title: Aoi and Teppei
description: If you could be reborn as someone else and live out a new life, who would you want to become? The latest work based on an original story by Fukumoto Nobuyuki! Striping bare the true nature of humans steeped in worldly desires, this is the ultimate reincarnation story that goes far beyond mere "what-ifs." The joys, rages, sorrows, and delights of useless scumbags—and the ultimate reverse gacha!
author: Fukumoto Nobuyuki, Fukumoto Takumi
